In figure $ABCD$ shown above, which of the following are equal to the vector $\overset{\to }{BO}?$

I. $\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AD}-\overset{\to }{OD}$

II. $\overset{\to }{OD}-\overset{\to }{OC}$

III. $\overset{\to }{OC}+\overset{\to }{CB}$
question.worked_solution:
- For the $1$st expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AD}-\overset{\to }{OD} & =(\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AD})+\overset{\to }{DO} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BD}+\overset{\to }{DO} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BO}\,✓\end{aligned}
$$

- For the $2$nd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{OD}-\overset{\to }{OC} & =\overset{\to }{OD}+\overset{\to }{CO} \\  & =\overset{\to }{CD} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{BO}\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

- For the $3$rd expression, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{OC}+\overset{\to }{CB} & =\overset{\to }{OB} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{BO}\,\times \end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "I only".
